sentences.text: Aggrieved by the award passed in MVC No.2689/2022 dated 15.02.2023 by the I Addl. Small Causes Judge & MACT, Bengaluru, the insurance company is before this court questioning the award on the ground that the owner of the offending vehicle has produced the fake driving license and after the disposal of the case they came to know that the said driving license is a fake license as such the insurance company is not liable to pay the compensation.

entities.text: I Addl. Small Causes Judge & MACT, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent submits that the principle of pay and recover will apply and without examining the concerned, this court cannot give a finding that the driving license that is placed before the court is a fake document.
3. Hence, considering the application that is filed before this court, this court deems it appropriate to set aside the award and remand the matter to the tribunal.
NC: 2025:KHC:35226 HC-KAR i.
Accordingly, the award passed in MVC.No.2689/2022 dated 15.02.2023 by the I Addl.
Small Causes Judge & MACT, Bengaluru is set aside as far as the issue of driving license and remanded back to the tribunal for fresh consideration.
ii. The insurance company shall adduce the necessary evidence on the limited issue of whether the driving license produced is a genuine document or not.
iii. Though notice is served on the owner of the vehicle, he has not appeared before the court.

iv. The insurance company without further notice,
shall appear before the tribunal on 22.09.2025 and shall adduce the evidence with regard to this and the court shall decide the same within a period of one month from the date of receiving the copy of the order.
v. Amount in deposit shall be forthwith transferred to the tribunal and the same shall be deposited in a FD.
vi. The Registry is directed to return the Trial Court Record to the Tribunal along with the certified copy of the order passed by this court forthwith without any delay.
NC: 2025:KHC:35226 HC-KAR vii.
Accordingly, the appeal is Allowed.
viii. No Costs.
ix. Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

SD/-
